image_prompts.Subject / Identity: Focus exclusively on describing the main subject's appearance, facial features, clothing, distinctive features like bracelet, tattoos, and overall identity.
image_prompts.Comprehensive: Analyze the entire image in extreme detail (subjects, environment, lighting, composition, mood, screen geography left/right/center, foreground/mid/background).
image_prompts.Action / Emotion: Analyze only the physical actions, body language, posture, gaze, and facial expressions, emotional progression.
image_prompts.Face & Expression Focus: Analyze the facial features, gaze, micro-expressions intimately, eyes, mouth, emotional state.
image_prompts.Prop & Object Interaction: Focus purely on what objects the subject is holding or interacting with, and how they interact, prop ownership.
image_prompts.Lighting & Camera: Describe only the camera angle/framing (e.g., close-up, wide shot, medium) and the ambient lighting setup (natural, neon, volumetric, practicals).
image_prompts.Cinematic Composition: Analyze framing techniques, depth of field, foreground/background separation, lens characteristics (wide 24mm, telephoto 85mm, macro), screen geography.
image_prompts.Style & Aesthetics: Focus solely on artistic style, color palette, texture, grain, mood, photographic vs anime vs 3D.
image_prompts.Color Palette & Texture: Focus exclusively on dominating colors, contrast ratios, visual textures, materials.
image_prompts.Identity Lock: Focus on identity preservation: face, hair, body proportions, clothing, distinctive props like bracelet, to lock for continuity, no drift.
image_prompts.Screen Geography: Focus on screen geography: who/what is frame left/right/center, foreground/mid/background, left/right relationships stable, eyelines.
image_prompts.Wardrobe / Prop: Focus on wardrobe, clothing, accessories, props, distinctive features for continuity locks.

video_prompts.Motion Focus: Focus strictly on choreography, speed, physical movement executed by subject, action order.
video_prompts.Comprehensive: Analyze sequential pacing, camera movement, subject motion across all keyframes, shot rhythm, transitions.
video_prompts.Camera Tracking: Focus entirely on tracking how virtual camera moves (panning, zooming, dollying, tracking, static, shake).
video_prompts.Temporal Flow: Analyze overall pacing, transitions, scene progression across extracted frames, shot list timing.
video_prompts.Physics & Momentum: Analyze realistic physics, gravity, weight, momentum of moving subjects/objects, contact, shadows.
video_prompts.Background Dynamics: Focus exclusively on what is moving in environment/background, ignoring main subject.
video_prompts.Condition Strength: Analyze how strongly keyframe/reference conditioning should be trusted - anchor strength, visual cond noise aug, audio cond noise aug.
video_prompts.Stereo Guard: Check audio reference - is it stereo 32kHz? Mono would crash sampler, needs duplication.
